skill.summary: Obsidian 노트나 텍스트를 dev-blog에 발행. Markdown → .mdoc 변환, 이미지 프롬프트 제공, 사용자가 직접 생성한 이미지 후처리, preview 배포 승인 후 main 배포까지 처리.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of blog-publisher.

- Publish Obsidian notes or text to dev-blog with automated workflow.
- Converts Markdown to `.mdoc` and assists with image prompt generation and processing (crop, webp).
- Supports both automated (via chatgpt-image-gen skill) and manual (user-provided) image workflows.
- Guides users through PR review (preview branch) and main deployment.
- Enforces frontmatter and image formatting rules for SEO and multi-language consistency.
